name: Paraiso Verde Philodendron
light: Bright indirect light for best coloration
tips: Brighter light brings out more variation in the greens. Mine sits near an east window and produces beautifully mottled leaves. Standard Philodendron care otherwise.

name: Burle Marx Variegata
water: Allow to dry slightly between waterings
tips: One of the easier variegated Philodendrons! It grows quickly in good conditions and handles average humidity. Prune to control size and encourage bushier growth.

light: Bright indirect light, essential for survival
tips: This one tests your skills. Leaves with too much white may need to be sacrificed for the plant's health. Provide bright light but protect from direct sun. Keep humidity high.

name: Strawberry Shake Philodendron
tips: Protect new leaves - they emerge delicate and colorful. Bright, filtered light maintains colors without burning. High humidity helps prevent crispy edges on variegated sections.

name: Philodendron Billietiae
tips: The orange petioles are the star - maintain humidity above 60% to keep them vibrant. Give it a support to climb and watch the leaves elongate dramatically.

name: Jose Buono Philodendron
tips: Give it room to grow! This becomes a substantial plant. Bright indirect light maintains variegation. Support with a sturdy moss pole as it matures.

name: Philodendron Tortum
light: Bright indirect to some direct light
tips: Water sparingly - those thin leaves don't need much moisture. Let it dry between waterings more than other Philodendrons. Bright light encourages more dramatic leaf dissection.

name: Florida Ghost Philodendron
light: Bright indirect light, protect white leaves
tips: New leaves need protection while white - indirect light only. As they green up, they become hardier. Patience is key; pushing growth too fast produces weak leaves.

name: Orange Marmalade Philodendron
tips: Warm temperatures bring out the best orange tones in new leaves. I keep mine in my warmest spot. Good light without direct sun produces the most vibrant colors.

name: Green Congo Nuclear
tips: One of the easiest large Philodendrons! It tolerates neglect and adapts to various light conditions. Perfect for beginners wanting a statement plant without the fuss.
